notes.title: 🛠️ Patch 1.02 is here 🛠️
notes.notes:
Bonjour Detectives,

A new patch for Agatha Christie - Hercule Poirot: The London Case has been deployed. Here is what you can expect:

Art: new gala photos added, higher res and better key stealing action
Fix for the pictures in dialogue not continuing on a mouse click
Fixed issues with the interaction icons
Added new, unique thinking animation for Poirot during dialogue scenes
Disabled fidget animation while conversations are active
Minor bugfix

📬 Stay connected!

notes.title: Patch Notes: build ID - 12653720
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has played Agatha Christie – Hercule Poirot: The London Case and to those who have provided feedback. We have been putting our Little Grey Cells to work to address bugs and issues since launch and we’re pleased to announce a new patch, which is now available for download (build ID – 12653720). 

This patch includes the following updates: 

  Increased walk speed for Poirot in the Museum’s Main Hall, Theatre Street, and the Church 
 Resolved intermittent issue with missing ambient sounds and footsteps
 Missing German VO for Evelyn in Chapter 3 has been added  
 German Text and VO mismatch has been corrected
 German and French voice cast have been added to the end game credits
 Missing glass prop during “champagne incident” cutscene in Chapter 1 has been added
If you find any bugs or experience technical issues related to the game, don't hesitate to mention it in Steam discussions, or email our support team at support@blazinggriffin.com. 

Don’t forget to also follow us on X for updates about the famous Detective Poirot’s early career, as well as more titles on the horizon. 

Thank you, 

The Blazing Griffin Games Team
